'''RAF Jelgava''' was a [[Latvia]]n [[football (soccer)|football]] club based in [[Jelgava]]. The foundation of the club is considered in 1988 and for the first two years there were two teams of RAF Jelgava which in 1990 merged into one. One of those played in the lower Soviet leagues, the other – in the [[Football Championship of the Latvian SSR|Latvian league]]."}}
